landmarks.name: Marina Beach
landmarks.hint: The world's second-longest urban beach, stretching 13 km along the Bay of Bengal

landmarks.name: Kapaleeshwarar Temple
landmarks.hint: A magnificent Dravidian-style temple dedicated to Shiva, with a soaring gopuram in Mylapore

landmarks.name: Fort St. George
landmarks.hint: India's first English fortress, built in 1644, now housing the Tamil Nadu state legislature

landmarks.name: Valluvar Kottam
landmarks.hint: A chariot-shaped monument dedicated to the Tamil poet-saint Thiruvalluvar in Nungambakkam

landmarks.name: Arignar Anna Zoological Park
landmarks.hint: One of India's largest zoological parks, home to the white tigers, in Vandalur

landmarks.name: Guindy National Park
landmarks.hint: One of the smallest national parks in India and the only one within a city, home to blackbuck

landmarks.name: Santhome Cathedral
landmarks.hint: A minor basilica built over the tomb of St. Thomas the Apostle, who reputedly brought Christianity to India

landmarks.name: Elliot's Beach
landmarks.hint: A quieter, cleaner beach in Besant Nagar at the southern end of the Marina Beach stretch

landmarks.name: Parthasarathy Temple
landmarks.hint: One of the oldest Vishnu temples in Chennai, built by the Pallava kings in the 8th century in Triplicane

landmarks.name: MA Chidambaram Stadium
landmarks.hint: One of India's oldest and most celebrated cricket grounds, known as Chepauk, home of Chennai Super Kings
